reason: My real pain is clients emailing me every week for status, and nothing here says clients can see anything or that there's a 'waiting on client' state. A client page only I can see doesn't stop those emails, and per-seat pricing is exactly what I left behind for Basecamp.
objection: Per person pricing means every contractor I bring in for a month costs me more, and there's no mention of letting clients or freelancers in for free, so I'd end up rationing seats.
would_change_my_mind: Free client and contractor access to a client-facing status view with a 'waiting on client' state, so the weekly status emails actually stop.
